steps.caption: P1: the ISP A link at HQ1-CORE-R1 Et0/2, colored by the ALMNJOY-BGP profile
KEEPALIVE: 19 bytes, header only. Type 04 just restarts the hold timer
IP SLA 10: echo to 100.200.1.1 every 5 s. Replies stop at 11:11:54
Probe refused: ICMP type 3 code 13, administratively prohibited (the ACL)
NOTIFICATION 15.4 s later: Cease (06) / Administrative shutdown (02)
ISP A knocks 9 times, every SYN gets a RST. The last SYN is R1's own, accepted
OPEN: My AS 65001 (fd e9), hold 180 s, router ID 10.255.1.1
Capabilities: MP IPv4 unicast, route refresh (128 + 2), enhanced RR (70), 4-byte AS (65)
ROUTE-REFRESH subtype 1 = BoRR: the table resend starts here
Frame 121: one TCP segment, 8 BGP messages. Last one is End-of-RIB (attributes length 0)
P2: the ISP B link at HQ1-CORE-R2 Et0/2, same clock as P1
11:12:14.644, 7 ms after R1's NOTIFICATION: ISP B offers 198.51.100.0/25, path 65200 65100 65001
The loop: FINs for 198.51.100.10 arrive with TTL 115, HQ answers TTL exceeded ~64 ms later
Inside the TTL-exceeded: the quoted packet died with TTL 1, about 114 hops after this wire
